title: Pharmacy and consumer health
note: Healthcare board only. Each feed was fetched successfully on 2026-10-27, or on 2026-10-28 for the four added that day. CVS Health is also polled for tech and finance (tech/ and shared/ health_tech); this source reads its Pharmacy Services, Clinical Pharmacists and Clinical Services job families. Loblaw's and Shoppers Drug Mart's Paradox sites are read only in their Pharmacy and Healthcare categories; Shoppers' 1,562 are mostly store pharmacy roles. Their main sites refuse plain requests, so the Shoppers and Rexall career hosts (on their own domains) were found by a web search. Rexall's site is read whole. Kenvue posts on Workday. Not added: Walgreens (22,585 postings, mostly store roles, and its Radancy site can't be narrowed); CVS Health's internships (about 4,000 store-level pharmacy intern postings, beyond the 2,000 Workday serves); Kroger (its Oracle feed repeats a page); London Drugs (CareerPlug); Jean Coutu (a custom portal); Sobeys (a Dayforce board behind a WordPress plugin); Haleon (unconfirmed, blocked); Rite Aid (not hiring).
